episodes.title: I Will Make You Invite Me to a Movie / Kaguya Wants to Be Stopped / Kaguya Wants It
episodes.summary: Introduction to Kaguya Shinomiya and Miyuki Shirogane antics with Chika Fujiwara at the side.

episodes.title: Kaguya Wants to Trade / Chika Wants to Go Somewhere / Miyuki Wants to Hide his Ignorance
episodes.summary: Miyuki and Kaguya find ways to appeal to each other in addition of a clueless Fujiwara.

episodes.title: Miyuki Shirogane Still Hasn't Done It / Kaguya Wants to Be Figured Out / Kaguya Wants to Walk
episodes.summary: Have a deeper understanding of Kaguya Shinomiya's mind and life.

episodes.title: Kaguya Wants Affection / The Student Council Wants It to Be Said / Kaguya Wants Him to Send It / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Talk
episodes.summary: The student council prepares to host a party for their sister school in France.

episodes.title: Kaguya Wants to Handle It / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Show Off / Kaguya Wants to Be Covered
episodes.summary: Chika Fujiwara appears to aid the people in need of help.

episodes.title: Yu Ishigami Wants to Live / Chika Fujiwara Wants to Test You / Kaguya Wants to Be Noticed
episodes.summary: Introducing Yu Ishigami and his elusiveness to be in the Student Council room.

episodes.title: Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Work / Kaguya Wants Him to Join In / Kaguya Wants to Control It
episodes.summary: A couple of student council members listens to over the top claims from their other members talking in the student council room.

episodes.title: Kaguya Wants Her to Say It / Miyuki Shirogane Can't Lose / Ishigami Closes His Eyes
episodes.summary: Kaguya tries her best to help the younger students and in the First Term Finals.

episodes.title: Kaguya Wants to Give a Gift / Chika Fujiwara Wants to Pay a Visit / About Kaguya Shinomiya, Part 1
episodes.summary: Kaguya got sick due to a plan gone wrong.

episodes.title: Kaguya Won't Forgive / Kaguya Wants to Forgive / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Go Somewhere
episodes.summary: Kaguya and Miyuki are trying to fix their relationship after what happened in the last episode.

episodes.title: Ai Hayasaka Wants to Get Soaked / Chika Fujiwara Really Wants to Eat It / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to See You I Can't Hear the Fireworks, Part 1
episodes.summary: Chika Fujiwara is having a great summer vacation so far, in contrast to Kaguya and Miyuki.

episodes.title: I Can't Hear the Fireworks, Part 2 / Kaguya Doesn't Want to Avoid Him
episodes.summary: Kaguya goes to see the fireworks and the summer vacation ends.

episodes.title: Ai Hayasaka Wants to Stave Them Off / The Student Council Has Not Achieved Nirvana / Kaguya Wants to Get Married / Kaguya Wants to Celebrate
episodes.summary: Ai replaces the coffee in Shirogane's cup with a decaf version, causing issues. The Student Council also plays a board game together and even tries to give romantic advice.

episodes.title: Kaguya Wants to Know / Kaguya Wants to Give a Gift / Chika Fujiwara Wants to Confirm It
episodes.summary: Kaguya goes on a shopping trip with Shirogane's sister in the hopes of getting the perfect birthday present. Chika becomes suspicious seeing how zealous Kaguya has become over it.

episodes.title: Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Gaze at the Moon / The 67th Student Council / Kaguya Doesn't Want to Say It
episodes.summary: The school year is ending and so is the run of the Student Council. All of the students reflect on past experiences and how they will move forward.

episodes.title: Ai Hayasaka Wants Him to Fall for Her / Kaguya Wants to Be Confessed To / Miko Iino Wants to Set Things Right
episodes.summary: Shirogane begins his re-election campaign and wants Kaguya to help him out, but that soon creates gossip around the whole school. Especially when Shirogane's rival for the election finds out about it.

episodes.title: Miyuki Shirogane Wants Girls to Fall for Him / Nagisa Kashiwagi Wants to Console / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Sing / Kaguya Wants to Kick Them Down
episodes.summary: Kaguya is distraught when Shiorgane shows up to school looking completely different, causing her to question if the feelings she has for him are genuine.

episodes.title: I Don't Want to Make Miko Iino Smile / I Want to Make Miko Iino Smile / Kaguya Isn't Getting Called
episodes.summary: Election Day has arrived as Shirogane and Miko compete in the race for office.

episodes.title: Kaguya Wants to Undress Him / Kaguya Wants to Make Him Let Go / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Make Her Read / Kaguya Love Aquarium
episodes.summary: Kaguya gains a strong desire to know what kind of underwear Shirogane wears and tries to figure it out. Then Ishigami and Shirogane try to convince Kaguya to read shojo manga.

episodes.title: Miko Iino Wants to Control Herself / Kaguya Doesn't Scare Easily / Kaguya Wants to Be Examined
episodes.summary: Iino desperately tries to keep her cool while interacting with the rest of the student council. Kaguya and Miyuki are then trapped together in a bizarre situation; one that Kaguya has a difficult time getting over.

episodes.title: Yu Ishigami Closes His Eyes, Part 2 / Kaguya Wants to Touch / Kaguya Doesn't Say No
episodes.summary: Miko Iino wants to resign from the Student Council. Meanwhile Ishigami has joined Cheerleader Squad.

episodes.title: Kei Shirogane Can't Speak / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Dance / Kobachi Osaragi Wants to Crack Down / Miyuki Shirogane's Dad Wants to Find Out
episodes.summary: Shirogane has to deal with familial issues involving his sister and dad as he also trains so that he can dance during the school's sports festival.

episodes.title: Yu Ishigami Closes His Eyes, Part 3 / Miyuki Shirogane and Yu Ishigami / Kyoko Otomo Doesn't Realize
episodes.summary: Ishigami is shaken up when an unexpected visit arrives at the sport festival.

episodes.title: The Student Council Would Like a Group Photo / The Student Council Is Going to Get That Group Photo / Chika Fujiwara Wants to Inflate
episodes.summary: The contest between Kaguya and Shirogane is still on. Kaguya loses something she held dear for a long time and in return, she gets something more special.

episodes.title: Miko Iino Wants to Be Soothed / Kaguya Doesn't Realize / Chika Fujiwara Wants to Battle
episodes.summary: After finally making her long awaited smartphone debut, Kaguya restlessly contemplates over how to respond to Shirogane's LINE message.

episodes.title: Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Mediate / Kaguya Wants to Take Him Out / Kaguya Wants to Interrupt
episodes.summary: Kaguya makes a big fuss when she learns that Shirogane was invited to a karaoke group date and orders Hayasaka to remove him from the venue.

episodes.title: Nagisa Kashiwagi Wants to Kill / Maki Shijo Wants to Take Action / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Be Believed
episodes.summary: Shirogane accidentally steps on a female student who had collapsed on campus, she then takes care of her in the Student Council room.

episodes.title: Kaguya Shinomiya's Impossible Demand: "A Cowrie a Swallow Gave Birth To" Part 1 / Yu Ishigami Wants to Prove Himself Worthy / Chika Fujiwara Wants to Stay Over
episodes.summary: Plans are made for a sleepover at Kaguya's house. Fujiwara gets excited about the totally hot butler Mr. Herthaka without realizing it's Hayasaka dressed as a man. A sleep-deprived Kaguya takes on a strange mood and calls Shirogane.

episodes.title: Chika Fujiwara Wants to Beat a Rhythm / Ai Hayasaka Wants to Talk / Maki Shijo Wants Some Help
episodes.summary: Miyuki requested Chika to train him on rapping. When Chika asked the reason, he answered that he wanted to convey his feelings to a girl. Kaguya and Ai arrived at the location that Miyuki requested. Back at the Student Council, Maki requested for another love consultation.

episodes.title: The Student Council Wants to Move Forward / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Make Her Confess, Part 2 / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Make Her Confess, Part 3
episodes.summary: Parent-Teacher Conferences to determine each student's future begin at Shuchiin Academy. Shirogane makes an important decision regarding the path he will follow.

episodes.title: Miko Iino Can't Love, Part 1 / Students Wish to Discuss the Culture Festival / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Blow It Up
episodes.summary: All classes are consumed in preparation for Shuchiin Academy's Hoshin Culture Festival. Fujiwara refuses to help Shirogane make balloon art. Shirogane heads to the Student Council room to practice but finds Shinomiya there.

episodes.title: Kei Shirogane Wants to Show Off / About Kaguya Shinomiya, Part 2 / Kaguya Wants to Confess
episodes.summary: Kei assembles an outfit for her brother to wear to the Culture Festival. Kaguya tries to sneak Shirogane a heart-shaped gift.

episodes.title: Spring of First Year / Kaguya's Culture Festival / Yu Ishigami's Culture Festival
episodes.summary: Shirogane remembers the first time he met Kaguya. Kaguya helps out at her class' cosplay cafe. Ishigami tries to ask out Tsubame.

episodes.title: Kozue Makihara Wants to Have Fun / Chika Fujiwara Wants to Unmask / Miyuki Shirogane's Cultural Festival
episodes.summary: Class 1-A and 1-B run a haunted house. Chika tries to convince her sister that Miyuki isn't a good boyfriend material. Chika and Miyuki discuss Yu's chances of success with Tsubame.

episodes.title: Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Make Her Confess, Part 4 / Tsubame Koyasu Wants to Say No / Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Make Her Confess, Part 5
episodes.summary: Kaguya tries to get Miyuki to give her a heart shaped balloon. Kaguya gives someone advice on how to reject a love confession. Miyuki spends time with Kaguya during the Culture Festival.

episodes.title: Kaguya Wants to Confess, Part 2 / Kaguya Wants to Confess, Part 3 / Dual Confessions, Part 1
episodes.summary: The Shuchiin Culture Festival reaches its climax, but Shirogane is nowhere to be found. Kaguya consults Hayasaka. The phantom thief Arsène strikes again. Tsubame confronts Ishigami.

episodes.title: Dual Confessions, Part 2
episodes.summary: Shroud in a cape and dressed in the guise of the phantom thief Arsène, Shirogane waited for Kaguya's arrival atop the clock tower roof overlooking Shuchiin. When they finally meet, Kaguya has something to say to him.
